title: Just Juice Bar Range Kiwi Cooler 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Kiwi Cooler from the Just Juice Bar Range is a cool, zesty fruit blend that balances vibrant Green Kiwi with refreshing Cucumber and a bright burst of Lime. The inhale delivers the sweet-tangy Kiwi and the mellow green smoothness of Cucumber, while the Lime adds a subtle citrus twist. A clean Ice finish rounds out the blend with a crisp, frosty exhale. Crafted with nicotine salts for fast-acting nicotine delivery and a smooth yet tactile throat hit, this e-liquid performs best in MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits, including pod systems and vape pens. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, it offers a flavour-packed vape with discreet vapour and minimal throat harshness. Just Juice Bar Range Nic Salts are made in the UK and blended at a 60PG/40VG ratio for a satisfying balance of flavour clarity and vapour. Inspired by popular disposable-style profiles, each flavour offers a chilled, fruit-driven vape in a refillable 10ml format. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
